# Docker Image Tags Reference for FRP (frpc & frps)

This document describes the Docker image tagging strategy for `frpc` and `frps`.

## Tag Naming Convention

All images use the format:

- `snowdreamtech/frpc:TAG` / `ghcr.io/snowdreamtech/frpc:TAG` / `quay.io/snowdreamtech/frpc:TAG`
- `snowdreamtech/frps:TAG` / `ghcr.io/snowdreamtech/frps:TAG` / `quay.io/snowdreamtech/frps:TAG`

Where `TAG` follows these patterns:

- **Variant-specific tags**: `latest-variant`, `nightly-variant`, `<version>-variant` (e.g., `latest-alpine`, `nightly-rocky`, `0.71.1-debian`)
- **Default tags** (Debian only): `latest`, `nightly`

## Supported Registries

All tags are pushed to three registries:

- **DockerHub**: `snowdreamtech/frpc:TAG`, `snowdreamtech/frps:TAG`
- **GitHub Container Registry**: `ghcr.io/snowdreamtech/frpc:TAG`, `ghcr.io/snowdreamtech/frps:TAG`
- **Quay.io**: `quay.io/snowdreamtech/frpc:TAG`, `quay.io/snowdreamtech/frps:TAG`

## Tag Scenarios

### 1. Branch Builds (dev/main)

#### Push to `dev` branch

```bash
git push origin dev
```

**Generated tags:**

```text
snowdreamtech/frpc:dev-alpine
snowdreamtech/frpc:dev-debian
snowdreamtech/frpc:dev-rocky
snowdreamtech/frps:dev-alpine
snowdreamtech/frps:dev-debian
snowdreamtech/frps:dev-rocky
```

#### Push to `main` branch

```bash
git push origin main
```

**Generated tags:**

```text
snowdreamtech/frpc:latest-alpine
snowdreamtech/frpc:latest-debian
snowdreamtech/frpc:latest-rocky
snowdreamtech/frpc:latest            # ← Debian (default)
snowdreamtech/frps:latest-alpine
snowdreamtech/frps:latest-debian
snowdreamtech/frps:latest-rocky
snowdreamtech/frps:latest            # ← Debian (default)
```

### 2. Release-Please Tag Builds

Tags generated by Release-Please: `alpine-v*`, `debian-v*`, `rocky-v*`

For example, when `debian-v0.71.1` is pushed:

```text
snowdreamtech/frpc:0.71.1-debian
snowdreamtech/frpc:latest-debian
snowdreamtech/frpc:latest            # ← Default variant
snowdreamtech/frps:0.71.1-debian
snowdreamtech/frps:latest-debian
snowdreamtech/frps:latest            # ← Default variant
```
